decision_context: Supply historical management guidance evidence to the CP-2G module proof loop; the receiving owner must validate applicability and retain its limits.
authorization_basis: Current user request to review and test the full workflow one module at a time, reusing existing work; read-only public evidence retrieval is within that scope.
exclusions: No sources published after 2024-11-07 in the answer; no later realised results, confidential queries, trade recommendations, current forecast claims or general sector study. No paid providers.

questions.question: What fiscal 2025 sales and EBITDA As Defined outlook and midpoint earnings bridge did TDG issue on November 7, 2024, and what limits its use as cash-flow forecast evidence?
questions.decision_relevance: Replace unsupported forecast revenue/earnings anchors with dated attributed management guidance; distinguish accrual inputs from cash assumptions.
questions.evidence_needed: Issuer release and original SEC exhibit; dated outlook, fiscal-period labels, midpoint earnings bridge and non-GAAP/forward-looking limitations.
questions.completion_test: Locate and retain the primary evidence; preserve amounts, periods, units, definitions, uncertainty and strongest contrary evidence; identify permitted and unsupported downstream uses.
